summary: Iteration 6 (Cashier Monitoring + Real QR + Online Orders Approval + Product image_url) end-to-end tested. Backend pytest: 29 passed, 1 skipped (only when no other-cashier shift exists). Frontend: SuperAdmin Cashier Monitor + Rekap/ShiftReport modal, Kasir POS Online Orders modal with Setujui reducing pending count, public /self-order?table=07 loads without auth, Tables page renders 12 real QR SVGs with Salin/Cetak buttons, PaymentModal QRIS tab shows real QR SVG + proof upload input. All new endpoints (GET /api/shifts, GET /api/shifts/{id}/report, GET /api/pos/online-orders, POST /api/self-order/{id}/accept) verified for RBAC, data isolation, and business rules.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1049 lines — well past the 700-line soft limit. Recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, pos, kds, shifts, self_order, settings, admin) to improve maintainability.
App.js is 1171 lines — also >700-line soft limit; extract CustomerSelfOrder, CashierMonitor, ShiftReportModal, OnlineOrdersModal, PaymentModal into src/pages/ or src/components/.

accept_self_order sets sale.subtotal = order.total but tax is hardcoded to 0 and total = subtotal — this may cause reporting drift vs POS sales which store subtotal + 10% tax = total. Consider normalising tax handling for self-orders.

shift_report unpaid/pending counts include ALL 'Menunggu kasir' self-orders regardless of shift/day — a shift closed at midnight will still see pending orders from other days. Consider filtering by date >= shift.opened_at.
expenses_total in shift_report is a SUM of ALL expenses in the DB, not scoped to the shift's date range — this over-reports expenses per shift.
PATCH /api/vendor/orders/{order_id} still takes status as raw query param (carryover from iter 5) — inconsistent with other PATCH endpoints.

CashierMonitor first render displays empty state until 5s polling fills; consider triggering load() eagerly on first mount (already done, but the state may still race with page nav). Suggest an initial 'Loading…' placeholder distinct from 'Belum ada shift'.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed self-orders, products, sales, shifts. Seeded merchants/products/users already present. Multiple self-orders created via unauth POST /api/self-order pile up in 'Menunggu kasir' queue — recommend a periodic cleanup task for TEST_ orders in prod-like envs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_mjd_kupi_full.py now has 30 tests covering iterasi 6 features: TestCashierMonitoring (RBAC + enrichment), TestShiftReport (structure + kasir-scope 403), TestOnlineOrdersAndAccept (list + accept creates sale + reduces stock + KDS tickets + 400 on re-accept + shift-required), TestSalesDataIsolation (kasir sees only own shift), TestProductImageUrl (base64 data URL roundtrip). Old test_self_order_creates_kitchen_tickets was replaced by test_self_order_no_auto_kds_but_visible_to_vendor to reflect new behaviour (self-orders NO LONGER auto-create KDS tickets — kasir must accept first). Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_mjd_kupi_full.py -v -o addopts=. Full run ~150s.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issues found. Frontend polling for CashierMonitor takes up to 5s on first mount which briefly shows empty state — cosmetic, not a bug; addressed via wait in tests.
